parts.t: Delta Manor is a walkable part of Ladner, with parks nearby and Ladner Village close by. Browse Delta Manor homes and townhouses for sale below, and contact me with any questions.
Delta Manor is a neighbourhood in Ladner. The streets are lined with trees, and most homes are older family houses on good-sized lots, with some renovated or newer ones mixed in.

The shops and restaurants in Ladner Village and the stores on Ladner Trunk Road are close by. If you care about which school your kids would go to, check the address with the Delta School District, because school areas can change.
